name: MIPS64 Pipeline Simulator
desc: Predict the pipeline diagram yourself, then compare it with the computed one. Hazards, stalls and forwarding. Now with Unit 3: the memory hierarchy. Includes the Pipeline Blitz game.

name: HCI & Java GUI Lab
desc: Java GUI (AWT/Swing), events, user-centred design and HCI fundamentals.

name: Data Structures Dojo
desc: Complexity, graphs, Dijkstra, Floyd, DFS, Prim, BST and AVL, with adjustable difficulty levels. Practice and daily puzzles.

name: Logic Lab
desc: Interactive logic practice with XP, streaks and solved-problem tracking. Propositional and first-order logic, including functions and natural deduction.

name: TEC Lab
desc: Electronics and computer technology, explained step by step. Move the sliders and watch it update live.

name: Halcyon Arcade
desc: Six games that teach by play: accessibility, CPU design, electronics, algorithms, logic and programming. Trophies, daily challenge, friend comparison and notes.
